items.title: Windows Remote Desktop Services 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild to Escalate Privileges
items.description: Microsoft has patched CVE-2026-21533, a zero-day elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows Remote Desktop Services (RDS) that attackers are exploiting in the wild to gain SYSTEM-level access.
